checks.text: On first load the page shows the heading "Image Diff", two drop zones for A and B, and a "Try a sample" button.
Pressing "Try a sample" shows the heatmap, the changed-pixel statistics and, under the Overlay tab, an overlay with a bounding box.
Two identical images show "No pixels differ above the threshold" and 0.00%.
When B has a different size, the notice "B was resized from WxH to WxH to compare" is shown and differing pixels are counted.
A file that is not a supported image shows an error that names the file and its type.
The last tab is remembered across reloads, and Clear returns to the empty state.
